managers.message_to_team: If you’ve got a natural moment, add something specific for the customer—name or order, not just a smiley. Don’t slow the line for it; during this rush, keep drinks moving.
managers.private_thought: At this volume, notes cost seconds on every cup and I don’t see a throughput or labor case for checking them.

managers.message_to_team: If there’s a natural moment, make the cup note personal—use their name or something from the interaction, not just a smiley. When that line’s building, focus on getting people served; this is an invitation, not one more thing to get judged on.
